notes: Fixes the phantom blank page printed between every label in batch jobs (24 total pages for 12 labels, alternating content/blank). Cause: each label was wrapped in an inline-block div with its own page-break-after rule, so Chromium print engine emitted an empty page per label plus a trailing blank. Batches now contain exactly N page nodes with the break only on the first N-1, zeroed box model so nothing can overflow the 40x20mm box, and a runtime assertion that the page-node count equals the copy count. Verified through Chromium print-to-PDF: 5 copies produce exactly 5 pages at 40x20mm, each with content, zero blanks. Credit receipts (store + customer copies) had the same empty-separator bug and are fixed too.
